source.sqlReaderQuery: DECLARE @DELTA_DATE DATETIME = ?  DECLARE @DELTA_DATE_KEY INT DECLARE @DELTA_TIME_KEY INT  SELECT @DELTA_DATE_KEY = DATE_KEY FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE WHERE DATE = CONVERT(DATE,@DELTA_DATE) SELECT @DELTA_TIME_KEY = TIME_KEY FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME WHERE TIME = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(TIME,@DELTA_DATE))  DECLARE @CURRENT_DATE_KEY INT  SELECT @CURRENT_DATE_KEY = DATE_KEY FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE WHERE DATE = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())  DECLARE @CASE_TYPE_ID INT  DECLARE @CASE_TYPE_IDS TABLE (CASE_TYPE_DESC VARCHAR(100),CASE_TYPE_ID INT,CALLLIST_CD VARCHAR(4)) INSERT INTO @CASE_TYPE_IDS (CASE_TYPE_DESC,CALLLIST_CD) VALUES ('Disease Management','329'), ('Case/Care Management - PH','329'), ('Chronic Care Management (TN only)','329'), ('Health Risk Management (TN only)','329'), ('DM Wellness Program','327')  DECLARE @CASE_STATUS_ID_OPEN INT DECLARE @CASE_STATUS_ID_SPECIALTY INT  SELECT @CASE_STATUS_ID_OPEN = STATUS_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_STATUS WHERE STATUS_DESC = 'Open' SELECT @CASE_STATUS_ID_SPECIALTY = STATUS_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_STATUS WHERE STATUS_DESC = 'Reopen'  DECLARE @CASE_PHASE_ID_POTENTIAL INT DECLARE @CASE_PHASE_ID_OPEN_ACTIVE INT DECLARE @CASE_PHASE_ID_OPEN_PASSIVE INT  SELECT @CASE_PHASE_ID_POTENTIAL = PHASE_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_PHASE WHERE PHASE_DESC = 'Potential' SELECT @CASE_PHASE_ID_OPEN_ACTIVE = PHASE_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_PHASE WHERE PHASE_DESC = 'Open/Active' SELECT @CASE_PHASE_ID_OPEN_PASSIVE = PHASE_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_PHASE WHERE PHASE_DESC = 'Open-Passive'  DECLARE @TASK_STATUS_ID_COMPLETE INT  SELECT @TASK_STATUS_ID_COMPLETE = STATUS_TYPE_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TASK_STATUS WHERE STATUS_TYPE_DESC = 'Complete'  UPDATE T SET CASE_TYPE_ID = DCT.CASE_TYPE_ID FROM @CASE_TYPE_IDS T 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_TYPE DCT ON DCT.CASE_TYPE_DESC = T.CASE_TYPE_DESC   SELECT DISTINCT DM.SUBSCRIBER_ID + '00' AS MEMBERNUMBER,T.CALLLIST_CD,DC.CASE_ID,DC.DIM_CASE_NAME AS CASE_NAME,DCS.STATUS_DESC AS CASE_STATUS,DCT.CASE_TYPE_DESC AS CASE_TYPE,DUEDATE.DATE + DUETIME.TIME AS TASK_DUE_DTM,TASKCREATEDATE.DATE + TASKCREATETIME.TIME AS TASK_CREATE_DTM,CASECREATEDATE.DATE + CASECREATETIME.TIME AS CASE_CREATE_DTM,CASEUPDATEDATE.DATE + CASEUPDATETIME.TIME AS CASE_UPDATE_DTM,0 AS ADDED_TO_CALLLIST,FMT.TASKSTATUS_ID,DU.LOGIN AS NURSE_ASSIGNED FROM @CASE_TYPE_IDS T 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_CASE FC ON T.CASE_TYPE_ID = FC.CASE_TYPE_ID 		AND @CURRENT_DATE_KEY BETWEEN FC.EFF_DATE AND FC.TERM_DATE 		AND FC.STATUS_ID IN (@CASE_STATUS_ID_OPEN,@CASE_STATUS_ID_SPECIALTY) 		AND FC.PHASE_ID IN (@CASE_PHASE_ID_POTENTIAL,@CASE_PHASE_ID_OPEN_ACTIVE,@CASE_PHASE_ID_OPEN_PASSIVE) 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE DC ON DC.CASE_KEY = FC.CASE_KEY 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_MEMBER DM ON DM.MEME_CK = DC.MEME_CK 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_MEMBER_FORM FMF ON FMF.MEME_CK = DC.MEME_CK 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_FORM DF ON DF.FORM_KEY = FMF.FORM_KEY 		AND DF.FORM_ID = 500478 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.[DW_FACT_MEMBER_TASK] FMT WITH (NOLOCK) ON FMT.MEME_CK = DM.MEME_CK 		AND FMT.TASKSTATUS_ID <> @TASK_STATUS_ID_COMPLETE 		AND FMT.SUBJECT = 'DM Member Status Form' 		AND (FMT.CREATE_DATE > @DELTA_DATE_KEY OR FMT.CREATE_DATE = @DELTA_DATE_KEY AND FMT.CREATE_TIME > @DELTA_TIME_KEY) 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_STATUS DCS ON DCS.STATUS_ID = FC.STATUS_ID 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_TYPE DCT ON DCT.CASE_TYPE_ID = FC.CASE_TYPE_ID 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE DUEDATE ON DUEDATE.DATE_KEY = FMT.DUE_DATE 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME DUETIME ON DUETIME.TIME_KEY = FMT.DUE_TIME 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE TASKCREATEDATE ON TASKCREATEDATE.DATE_KEY = FMT.CREATE_DATE 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME TASKCREATETIME ON TASKCREATETIME.TIME_KEY = FMT.CREATE_TIME 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE CASECREATEDATE ON CASECREATEDATE.DATE_KEY = DC.CREATE_DATE 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME CASECREATETIME ON CASECREATETIME.TIME_KEY = DC.CREATE_TIME 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE CASEUPDATEDATE ON CASEUPDATEDATE.DATE_KEY = FC.UPDATE_DATE 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME CASEUPDATETIME ON CASEUPDATETIME.TIME_KEY = FC.UPDATE_TIME 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_USER DU ON DU.USER_ID = FMT.USER_ID

scripts.text:
UPDATE C
SET CALLLIST_CASE_TASK_DUE_DATE = S.CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_TASK_DUE_DATE,
	CALLLIST_CASE_UPDATE_DATE = S.CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_UPDATE_DATE
FROM PDS_CALLLIST_CASES C
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_CASES_STAGING S ON S.CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_CASE_ID = C.CALLLIST_CASE_CASE_ID

INSERT INTO PDS_CALLLIST_CASES ([CALLLIST_CASE_CASE_ID],
[CALLLIST_CASE_CASE_NAME],
[CALLLIST_CASE_MEMBERNUMBER],
[CALLLIST_CASE_CASE_STATUS],
[CALLLIST_CASE_CASE_TYPE],
[CALLLIST_CASE_NURSE_ASSIGNED],
[CALLLIST_CASE_CALLLIST_CD],
[CALLLIST_CASE_TASK_DUE_DATE],
[CALLLIST_CASE_ADDED_TO_CALLLIST_IND],
[CALLLIST_CASE_CREATE_DATE])
SELECT [CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_CASE_ID],
[CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_CASE_NAME],
[CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER],
[CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_CASE_STATUS],
[CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_CASE_TYPE],
[CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_NURSE_ASSIGNED],
[CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD],
[CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_TASK_DUE_DATE],
[CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_ADDED_TO_CALLLIST_IND],
[CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_CREATE_DATE]
FROM PDS_CALLLIST_CASES_STAGING S
	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_CASES C ON S.[CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_CASE_ID] = C.[CALLLIST_CASE_CASE_ID]
WHERE C.[CALLLIST_CASE_CASE_ID] IS NULL

DECLARE @DELTADATE DATETIME

SELECT @DELTADATE = ISNULL(MAX(CALLLIST_CASE_STAGING_DELTA_DATE),'1/1/1901') FROM PDS_CALLLIST_CASES_STAGING

IF @DELTADATE <> '1/1/1901'
	UPDATE PDS_CONFIGURATIONS SET CONFIGURATION_VALUE = CONVERT(VARCHAR,@DELTADATE,120) WHERE CONFIGURATION_FILTER = @DeltaDate_ConfigurationFilter
